snippet.title: Arizona Sunshine - Release Date Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Vertigo Games is bringing its hit VR zombie series to flat screens as a fully reimagined third-person shooter for PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC. Play as Sunny on a road trip through a zombie-filled Arizona with his dog Buddy, either solo or in online and split-screen co-op, where Buddy is fully playable for the first time.
